headline: London Metal Exchange Base Metals Bounce as Nickel Leads Recovery
summary: Base metals on the London Metal Exchange rebounded, led by a 3.7% rise in nickel and a 1.9% increase in copper following previous losses driven by US rate hike concerns and AI spending doubts.
why: Industrial metal price fluctuations reflect shifting macroeconomic expectations and global industrial demand sentiment.

impacts.name: Copper
impacts.why: Broad recovery across base metals lifts exchange-traded futures contracts.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Bargain hunting and relief from prior selling pressures drove a broad-based rebound across LME industrial metals.
